Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an arithmetic misinterpretation when comparing birth years of directors. The birth year of Jorge Brum do Canto was incorrectly noted as 1963, rather than the correct 1910. This led to the mistaken conclusion that Monte Hellman, born in 1929, was the director born earlier. The error likely stems from a typographical mistake or a misunderstanding of the data retrieved, leading to the final erroneous decision that Hellman was older.
